_comment: Recorded identities of the primary constellation toolchain, for S0 D5.
Each entry binds a NAME to a source COMMIT and the SHA-256 of the binary
attested to have been built from it. The commit is the identity; sha256 is
what makes the attestation checkable afterwards, so a binary swapped on
PATH later is caught. `version` is recorded ONLY so a gate record can show
what the binary claims about itself -- it never accepts or refuses.
The three oracles come from THREE DIFFERENT repos; do not assume one.
Recorded 2026-08-14. Each repo was verified clean at the commit below at
the moment of recording, EXCEPT mnemonic-secret, which had 3 modified
files -- so its commit is a weaker attestation than the other two and is
marked. Re-record with scripts, not by hand, when any oracle is rebuilt:
